# opentype.js 1.3.4

`opentype.min.js` - opentype.js 1.3.4 (MIT licence, https://github.com/opentypejs/opentype.js), the exact file the EdgeLabel and
Classic Pro label generators vendor in their `vendor/` folder. A UMD build: `js/label-text.js` loads it with a script tag, only
when a build has label text to show, and reads `window.opentype`.
